name: sensei_ingest_fact_categorized
description: learn with category: modifier compiles successfully in an agent handler
input:
exportable agent test_agent
  knowledge store: ".forge-knowledge/test"
    max_entries: 100
    retention: 30d

  on ingest_fact(category: Text, fact: Text)
    learn "[{category}] {fact}" category: category
    say "Learned [{category}]"
